items.example: In New York people often didn't offer help because it was dangerous.
items.mnemonic: Добряк машет офертой — offer to help, предложить помощь.

items.example: People in Spanish-speaking cities seemed happy to give their time.
items.mnemonic: Хелпер улыбается — он a helpful person, отзывчивый человек.

items.example: People in these cities gave help with a smile.
items.mnemonic: Прохожий дарит смайл и помогает с улыбкой — give help with a smile.

items.example: When someone is in trouble, do they stop and help or just walk on by?
items.mnemonic: Волк проходит мимо — walk on by, не помочь.

items.example: A person with a broken leg drops some papers and can't pick them up.
items.mnemonic: Альпинист на пике поднимает бумаги — pick them up.

items.example: She's carrying a heavy suitcase and she can't lift it.
items.mnemonic: Грузчик толкает пушку — to push, толкать.

items.example: Can I carry your bag? — Yes, please, it's heavy.
items.mnemonic: Носильщик несёт карри в сумке — carry a bag, нести сумку.

items.example: I can't reach the dictionary on the top shelf.
items.mnemonic: Коротышка тянется через речку — reach something, дотянуться.

items.example: A blind person is trying to cross the road, but the traffic is busy.
items.mnemonic: Слепой держит блин вместо трости — это a blind person.

items.example: People in New York were often too busy or were in a hurry.
items.mnemonic: Прохожий с хурмой бежит в спешке — in a hurry.

items.example: A man is lying on the ground and he isn't moving.
items.mnemonic: Прохожий лёг на грунт — lie on the ground, лежать на земле.

items.example: People didn't offer help because people got angry with them.
items.mnemonic: Птица энгри бёрдз сердится — get angry, рассердиться.

items.example: Let me try ... Ooh, it's stuck.
items.mnemonic: Дверь застряла как стакан в подстаканнике — be stuck.

items.example: Do you need help? — Thanks, but no.
items.mnemonic: Добряк ставит акцепт на помощь — accept help, принять помощь.

items.example: Do you need help with your luggage?
items.mnemonic: Носильщик с нитью спрашивает нужна ли помощь — do you need help.
